feature: NEAR AI issues the verdict under E2EE v2: the facts go sealed to the attested model key, the model derives the predicates and echoes a binding of the envelope, and `make verify` checks the TDX quote (dcap-qvl, Intel root, committed PCS collateral), report_data (signing key and our nonce), the TEE signature over the exact wire bytes, the sealed answer (opened with a disclosed one-time key), predicates equal to the code's, and the binding
detail: one live capture on synthetic facts (chat `08af1d014f2d4f379dba94094562d9ba`, TCB UpToDate). On chain, `submit_near_ai_verdict` accepts it only with a registered model attestation (same nonce), the TEE signature over the exact response bytes, and a sealed answer that opens with the disclosed key and echoes this envelope's binding; `make verify` runs the contract on it and on 4 refusals. The quote check itself happens before `register_model_attestation`, not in the contract; NVIDIA GPU evidence is not checked

feature: OutLayer worker as referee: signed result (<= 900 bytes) checked by the contract with `ed25519_verify`; `settle` requires the receipt

feature: dispute arbiter: re-checks citations and every signature, signs upheld or overturned; an overturned receipt is cleared and settle is blocked

feature: sealed reviews (Semaphore v4): a settled purchase joins the merchant's group (LeanIMT, Poseidon on chain); during a round a member posts a sealed rating with a Groth16 proof checked on `alt_bn128` host functions, one per member per round (nullifier scoped to merchant and round); after the round members reveal, only if the group has k >= 5; release is batched and sorted by hash; `best_quote` breaks price ties by the score and takes a `min_score` floor
detail: 2 rounds of 6 sealed ratings released on testnet; 13 contract tests on real Semaphore proofs

feature: conserved delegation: standing flows from a merchant's released ratings along hire edges to the sub-agents it hires (w = 1/2), following a design rule in REP's draft "(an unpublished REP draft)": the whole chain gets at most w/(1-w) of the seed
detail: standing flowed from m01's released ratings to m02 and m03 on testnet; property test over random graphs with rings

feature: verifiable compute (Jolt zkVM), four guests: standing graph, price stack, referee, cohort k >= 5. detail: all four guests proved and verified (prove 1.3 to 9 s, verify about 60 ms, proofs 80 to 93 KB); standing proved twice over the live graph and posted on testnet
